name: Linear
summary: Issue tracking and project planning for product teams, with Triage Intelligence, the vendor's LLM step that analyzes every new issue in a team's triage inbox against existing issues to suggest assignee and labels and surface likely duplicates. For agents it publishes a hosted MCP server that finds, creates and updates issues, projects and comments, connecting to a Linear workspace by OAuth 2.1 by default or with an API key or OAuth token as a bearer; measured 401 with an OAuth challenge and no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-23 keyless: initialize answers 401 at /mcp and at /mcp/readonly. Since 09-17 the challenge has dropped error=invalid_token and its JSON body, and now names scope 'read write' at BOTH endpoints, while /mcp/readonly's own metadata document names scope read alone.

jobs.summary: Vendor claim, not measured: delegating a Linear issue starts a coding session 'through Claude Code or Codex' in a managed sandbox; 'Linear drafts a PR and adds a diff to the issue', which a member reviews and can merge from Linear. Basic, Business and Enterprise; usage draws AI credits.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-23: no surface prices an agent call or speaks a 402. Agent work (coding sessions, Loops) draws a prepaid workspace AI-credit balance with published unit prices; only a human admin tops it up, and the vendor says credit cards are the only method. Seats bill by card and invoice.
